active_set_policy: Read active IDs from config/brand64-active-brands.json. Filter the primary daily file to active IDs, then merge active_daily_overlay_paths. The old 10 rows remain preserved in the primary historical file but are excluded from the active 64. New PAL IDs BR-00065..BR-00074 start with a 2026-08-18 baseline and do not claim prior-day changes.
comparison_policy: Use the previous daily_path and previous product baseline only where the same active brand/product fields are comparable. New PAL brands are baseline-only on 2026-08-18. Do not claim no-change when product-level fields were not previously comparable. Official indexes/search results with non-live crawl timestamps may recover source coverage or create a baseline, but must not be treated as same-day launch, markdown, reservation-state, or stock change without a current product-page confirmation.
offline_policy: Never delete a known product when an official page becomes unavailable. Preserve last confirmed fields and mark SOURCE_OFFLINE with the last confirmed date.
conflict_policy: Do not overwrite a fresher baseline with stale or conflicting index/search values. Record SOURCE_STATE_CONFLICT and require a live product-page recheck.
dedupe_policy: Deduplicate by official product URL and manufacturer product code when available. If neither is available, use brand plus exact product title only as a temporary discovery key until the product page is captured.
brand_id_policy: Never reuse an inactive BR-ID for a new brand. Inactive brands remain INACTIVE_LEGACY_REFERENCE with history preserved.
